is_standard_polymer_type: check if a given chain type string is a standard protein, DNA, or RNA polymer
guess_polymer_type: guess whether a chain is protein, RNA, or DNA based on a list of residue names
fix_non_standard_polymer_res: convert a non-standard residue name to the closest standard protein, RNA, or DNA residue name
review_mmcif_chain_constants: review the mmCIF chain type constants like PROTEIN_CHAIN, DNA_CHAIN, and RNA_CHAIN for entity classification
review_mmcif_bond_constants: review the mmCIF bond type constants like COVALENT_BOND, HYDROGEN_BOND, and DISULFIDE_BRIDGE
